required_status_checks: Human Impact Cross-Repo Gate V1 / validate-human-impact-contract

provider_mutation_boundary.reason: The connected GitHub surface exposes branch/ruleset readback but no administration mutation action for branch protection or rulesets.

existing_producer.note: This producer can apply a protection payload when invoked from a surface carrying an explicit Administration:write credential. Its default Mapa context must not be blindly substituted for the RafGitTools-specific required checks in the canonical RafGitTools policy.

closure_gate: Authorized administrative surface applies the canonical RafGitTools policy or an equivalent/stronger provider policy.
Re-read main and require unchanged expected SHA during configuration transaction.
Provider readback reports protected=true or an effective ruleset covering main.
Required status checks are actually bound.
At least one approving review is required.
Force-push and deletion protections are observed.
A bounded negative PR proves the provider refuses merge when a required check fails or review is absent.
falsifier: Any fresh readback with protected=false, no effective ruleset, missing required checks, missing review requirement, or a merge accepted despite a deliberately failed required gate keeps provider enforcement unresolved.
f_ok: Canonical RafGitTools provider policy already exists and names repository-specific required checks.
Current main SHA and exact provider state were re-read after PR 423 merged.
The lack of provider enforcement is now separated from source/CI success.
f_gap: Administration:write mutation is not exposed in the connected execution surface.
main remains unprotected and has no rulesets.
No zero-approval or failed-check server rejection receipt exists for the current policy.
f_next: Apply the existing canonical RafGitTools provider policy from an authorized administration-capable surface, immediately re-read provider state, then perform the bounded negative merge-rejection test and append its receipt.
